review_notes: I read the whole file. The candidate is real: three theorems repeat the same "extend a positive-time derivative to a right derivative at 0" argument, which uses the `Ioi 0` set, `hlim.congr'` and `.deriv.symm`. I found no other repeated machinery that clears the rubric. The `slope_apply` product rules and the `realHeatList_*` induction lemmas are different arguments, and each is short. The one-sided and two-sided product rules in `EulerStrongOperatorDerivative` are near-duplicates, but they are two short proofs with different filters. I did not treat them as a separate finding.

claims.reason: The three `_generator_zero` proofs have the same structure. Each builds a `Tendsto` of the half-generator along `𝓝[>] 0` from continuity of the generator family. Each then applies `hasDerivWithinAt_Ici_of_tendsto_deriv (s := Set.Ioi 0)` with differentiability from the positive-time `HasDerivAt`, and closes with `hlim.congr'` and `(…generator_pos …).deriv.symm`. Only the family, its continuity lemma and its time-zero simplification differ. A general lemma fits all three under their real hypotheses. Each positive-time theorem already gives `HasDerivAt φ (ψ t) t` for all `0 < t`. Each has a continuous φ and a continuous ψ: `realLineHeat_continuous`, `realHeatList_continuous`, and the cylinder composite `(cylinderHeat_continuous ..).comp continuous_real_toNNReal`. The lemma only needs `NormedAddCommGroup E` and `NormedSpace ℝ E`. It has no dependency cycle, because it is stated before the first use and uses only Mathlib. The lemma is a short filter argument, not a trivial wrapper around the Mathlib lemma. It packages the choice of `s`, the `Tendsto` from continuity of ψ, and the `.deriv` rewriting. That choice and rewriting are the repeated part. Each caller would shrink to its continuity facts, its positive-time generator and a time-zero `simpa`. The gain is modest but real. The rewritten cylinder case needs its `simpa` to unfold `realCylinderHeat` at 0. I have not compiled this.

theorem hasDerivWithinAt_Ici_zero_of_pos {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {φ ψ : ℝ → E} (hφ : Continuous φ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hd : ∀ t, 0 < t → HasDerivAt φ (ψ t) t) : HasDerivWithinAt φ (ψ 0) (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
  apply hasDerivWithinAt_Ici_of_tendsto_deriv (s := Set.Ioi 0)
    (fun t ht => (hd t ht).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    hφ.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt self_mem_nhdsWithin
  refine (hψ.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt (s := Set.Ioi 0)).tendsto.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
  exact (hd t ht).deriv.symm
